hotel.name: The Westin Mission Hills Resort & Spa

verified_facts.text: The resort is a 360-acre escape in Greater Palm Springs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover The Westin Rancho Mirage Golf Resort & Spa, a serene 360-acre escape in Greater Palm Springs.

verified_facts.text: The resort is at 71333 Dinah Shore Drive, Rancho Mirage, California.
verified_facts.excerpt: 71333 Dinah Shore Drive, Rancho Mirage, California, USA, 92270

verified_facts.text: The resort has a Pete Dye-designed championship golf course on site.
verified_facts.excerpt: Play on our Pete Dye-designed championship course

verified_facts.text: The Pete Dye course is set among rolling hills with views of the surrounding desert mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set among beautiful rolling hills it offers spectacular sights of the surrounding desert mountains

verified_facts.text: The resort has three themed pools, each with its own programming.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Rancho Mirage family resort boasts three uniquely themed pools, each offering distinct programming.

verified_facts.text: Las Brisas, the largest pool, has dual 125-foot waterslides, cabana rentals and two bubbling spas.
verified_facts.excerpt: This pool features dual 125-foot waterslides, cabana rentals, two bubbling spas, and pool attendants at your service throughout the day.

verified_facts.text: La Paloma Pool offers a tranquil setting to relax and unwind.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Paloma Pool is located between buildings 3, 4, and 5 and offers a tranquil setting to relax and unwind.

verified_facts.text: The full-service spa and salon has a therapy pool, eucalyptus steam rooms and a relaxation lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our full-service spa and salon, features 9 massage rooms, 3 facial rooms, a therapy pool, eucalyptus steam rooms, and a relaxation lounge.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers the HaloIR, which combines an infrared sauna with salt therapy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in the HaloIR™ sauna, combining infrared technology and salt therapy.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have views of the mountains and desert landscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: We offer spacious Rancho Mirage family hotel suites with luxury amenities and stunning views of the mountains and desert landscape.

verified_facts.text: Premium options include Deluxe Golf View Rooms, an Executive Suite and Presidential Suites, with golf course views.
verified_facts.excerpt: From panoramic golf course vistas to spacious layouts and upscale touches, our Deluxe Golf View Rooms, Executive Suite, and Presidential Suites

verified_facts.text: Fireside Lounge sits on the 18th hole of the Pete Dye Golf Course and serves tapas and cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 18th hole of the Pete Dye Golf Course, this Rancho Mirage restaurant near Palm Springs offers tapas and cocktails.

verified_facts.text: Pinz & Pints has duckpin bowling lanes, draft beers, brewpub eats and classic arcade games.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pinz & Pints in Rancho Mirage is home to four lanes of duckpin bowling, ten draft beers at the bar, brewpub eats, classic arcade games

verified_facts.text: The resort has pickleball and tennis courts and lap pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Rancho Mirage hotel with waterslides, pickleball and tennis courts, lap pools, and an on-site championship golf course

verified_facts.text: Tennis, pickleball and padel lessons, clinics and open play run from September to June.
verified_facts.excerpt: From September to June, enjoy a range of programs, including tennis, pickleball, and padel lessons, clinics, and open play.

verified_facts.text: Golf clinics run from October to May.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our clinics are from October to May.

verified_facts.text: Pet-friendly rooms offer a Westin Heavenly Dog Bed and a Patio Pooch Menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our pet-friendly hotel rooms offer a Westin Heavenly® Dog Bed and a Patio Pooch Menu

verified_facts.text: All rooms have Westin Heavenly Beds and Westin Heavenly Baths.
verified_facts.excerpt: All our Rancho Mirage family hotel rooms feature Westin Heavenly® Beds and Westin Heavenly® Baths
